Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through how Cardinal Health is approaching clinical documentation normalization. I promised to share the recording and the two-slide cost/latency summary we discussed — both are attached and also linked below.

Quick recap / next steps: 
- Recording: 18-minute demo focused on batching, prefix caching, and model fallbacks.
- Slides: one-pager with expected latency and cost delta for a 3k token median route.
- Ask: will this feature be part of your Q4 prioritization for the pilot? If yes, I can loop in Solutions (cc’d) for a quick technical sync.

If it helps, I can book a focused 15-minute Q&A to answer any model/infra questions — I’ve found a short slot is enough to confirm feasibility and next milestones. Are any of these windows good for you next week?

  - Tue 10/13 — 9:30–10:00 PT
  - Wed 10/14 — 11:00–11:30 PT
  - Thu 10/15 — 13:00–13:30 PT
